Container.Name: Hevy Progress
Container.Overview: Colorful, self-hosted analytics dashboard for Hevy workout data. Track consistency, strength progression, training volume, muscle balance, recovery, personal records, monthly reports and your full workout calendar. Sync workouts and available body measurements through the Hevy API, or import workout CSV exports. The Measurements tab also supports manual entries and history charts. Includes workout history filters, quick date presets, pinned overview metrics, and clear sync status. Built primarily for my own training workflow and shared for others who may find it useful; your data, training style and preferences may differ, so some mappings, goals, analytics, defaults or settings may need adjustment. Unofficial project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Hevy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: hevy fitness workout gym training analytics progress exercise
Container.Requires: Optional Hevy API key for automatic workout and body-measurement sync. Workout CSV import and manual body measurements work without an API key.
Container.Changes: Automatic Hevy body-measurement import, history and source labels; workout filters, quick date presets, pinned metrics and clearer sync timestamps. Removed global search and collapse buttons. Updated README, FAQ, API notes and Unraid upgrade documentation. No new container settings required.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Hevy Progress dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and application data.

Config.Name: Hevy API Key
Config.Description: Optional Hevy API key for automatic workout and available body-measurement synchronization. Leave blank for workout CSV import and manual body measurements.

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Optional dashboard username. Set both username and password to enable HTTP Basic Authentication.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Optional dashboard password. Use HTTPS if accessing the dashboard outside your trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for workout dates, calendar days and week boundaries.

Config.Name: Sync Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between automatic Hevy API syncs. Minimum effective value is 300 seconds.
